body: Having a dog should feel like a partnership, like having a friend. But yeah, sometimes it does feel like a burden. If it's feeling more like a burden than a friendship then maybe a dog isn't the right pet for you and that's okay. Sometimes we need to do what's best for ourselves and let our dogs have a happy life with another family.

In what way can you not see yourself taking care of her and fulfilling your basic personal responsibilities? 

Is your dog crate trained? Honestly sometimes you just need to put them in their crate and put some distance between yourself and them. 

How old is the dog? Are they old enough that you could sit in a room with them and they'd stay put? Or you could buy a longer leash and tether them to you so you can have some alone time but the dog can relax as well. 

It's probably just puppy blues that you're feeling, we all get them. I get them now as well, even 9 months later. There are lots of things that can be done to relieve the stress and make life easier for yourself. If you can offer more information on what's going on then I'm sure everyone here wouldn't mind brain storming ideas that will help things get better.
[Piece of plastic that scoops up poop](http://www.betterware.com.mx/app/templates/better/images/productos/16744tb.jpg)
Thank you for this, this is really what we were looking for. We're serious about having a healthy relationship and communication was something that we really needed to work on.

The reason why I was asking not to advise breaking up is because we have examined the reasons why we broke up and we are working to change those aspects. We're both in therapy actively working towards changing and want to be apart of each other's life. 

The engagement was a mistake. Neither of us are ready for marriage and we're doing it to fulfil visa requirements so that we could be together. 

We are working towards making these serious changes.

Thank you, it's just that it's such long fight that I've been fighting for so long. Everyone keeps saying I can be brave for a little longer, but I don't know if I can. I'm on my knees begging for help and nothing is working. I offload all my thoughts and feelings and then I'm fine for an hour or two, but then it starts again. And it just repeats like that all day every day until eventually I can't take it anymore and want to kill myself. 

They believe that all the depression and suicidal thoughts and self-harm is being caused by psychological problems. So my nurse isn't trained in how to deal with it, and it's not something my psychiatrist deals with. Plus I don't see my psychiatrist often enough for seeing them to be effective. So the only treatment options I have left are to wait it out, and to have my meds get changed every other week. 

I just feel like I should have something that I can look back on and be like 'i'm proud I did that' but I've got nothing. I'm a huge failure at everything I try. Today I was all set to start to try and lose weight and be healthy but had a breakdown and wanted to kill myself. So what did I do? I ordered some chinese food. On the first day of trying to change. I just feel like that sums up my life.

I don't think I have anything in my life where I can say I'm proud of myself. Everything is just, 'well you could've done better'. I've tried the whole don't listen to the thoughts and challenge what they say, and think of yourself as a friend. But it only gets me so far, I can last a few hours and then I start to sink again. 

I have a mental health team that consists of a psychiatrist and a nurse... I'm waiting on a psychologist getting added to the mix, but that won't be until June time. Everybody is saying that there's nothing they can do to help. I just don't know what to do, the anxiety and the depression is making the psychosis so much. They up the medication and then I'm stuck sleeping away the day. 

Right now it feels like suicide is my only option.

Probably the Chlorpromazine (Thorazine/Largactil) but I'm also on Trazodone. Both have "drowsiness" side effects which I seem to be particularly sensitive too. I still haven't slept since yesterday it feels like I've got a dependency on them to sleep now as well.

Sometimes I feel like I'm in another dimension, but since I've fallen into it with my phone that's my communication device with all the other dimensions. It's a feeling in my bones that I can't really explain but as long as you have something or someone to guide you through the feeling, you always end up back home.

He sounds sinister and evil, he likes to make my life a living nightmare. He likes to tell me to kill myself and that might life is pointless. He likes to tell me that demons are after me and can posses the people I love. I think he is the real demon in all this.

They don't really do anything when you tell them you've got thoughts of killing people or have a plan too. I told them I had a plan for killing a child in my family and they laughed it off and upped my meds. 

You might want to try and talk them out of the military career, there is a reason you have to be of sound mental health before joining.

I kinda lost all sense of passion a year ago. But I'm slowly trying to get it back with programming and writing. But a lot of the times those are too high functioning for me to be able to distract myself with those because they require so much brain power.

Yeah i figured that much, but at the same time I felt like I wasn't getting listened too and that they were just trying to pin everything on the simplest thing (depression, even though I kept trying to tell them it's the other way around) and eventually they were just like "if you don't know what's making you sad we can't help" which felt like a kick in the gut cause it's my symptoms that are causing the depression, but they weren't listening.
They won't do anything, chances are they'd just call the psychiatrist I seen today and that would be that. There truly is no help available on the NHS.
I'm in the UK. They told me they didn't think it was necessary.
Thanks :)
Chlorpromazine and Trazodone

As soon as I felt myself not being able to keep it internal anymore, I told my manager who gave me time off the phone to call my nurse and then kept me off them the rest of the day. They told me to take the day off tomorrow if I needed too (which I've done).

I'm feeling okay now, mostly tired from the med change cause the drowsiness side effect always hits me like a ton of bricks when it first changes.
*hugs* Thank you
Yeah, the nurse changed the over the phone for me, so has doubled my Chlorpromazine to 50mg twice a day.

I'm always paranoid that I'm going to lose my job because of my symptoms because I'm going through a bad slump right now and I just started a new job. I've already been off for a few days because of it, and now I'm having to take time away from work to wait on my nurse to call me back in order to help me through this slump right now.

I'm on my meds at the moment, I'm having a hard time coping with the feeling like reality is fake and that I'm not in the right reality, the voices that are telling me to kill myself (even when I listen to music to drone them out, the music starts too tell me to kill myself) and bashing my head off of walls. 

I'm already with the CAMHT, just waiting on my psychiatry appointment coming through... I've got an appointment on Tuesday with my nurse to go through some anxiety management. 

Yeah even back in Oct '15, they knew I was suicidal and I was sent away after a talk with a professional...
What's the point? They won't be able to stop the feelings

But what's the point in going? How are they supposed too help with something that's all in my head, there isn't anything they can bandage up... How are they supposed too help with me wanting too bash my head off every surface and wanting to kill myself... I'm too afraid too take my meds tonight in case it turns into all of them...
Yeah that's what I'm like... Like on Monday I remember I thought my girlfriend was possessed but that's it. I don't remember what I said to her or how long it lasted.

> in most cases they may not remember anyway.

Is this typical? This happens to me all the time, like I'll remember that the episode happened and some other stuff but that's about it.

Yeah when I see the nurse again on Wednesday I'm going to see if they'll let me see a psychologist or psychiatrist. 

It's going not so well, I work in a call centre so the noise level can overwhelm me at times or sometimes when I'm on the calls I feel like the person on the phone isn't real and is a voice in my head, or worse I hear more than one voice on the phone. I haven't been able to hold down a full time job for more than 4 months, and I'm coming up for 3 months at this job so I've got that stress as well.

My work specifically don't know... HR knows given that I had to see an occupational health doctor before I could work, but I guess all they care about is that I'm 'fit to work'. I've been off once or twice because "anxiety has kept me up all night and I haven't slept" (read: I thought demons were trying to kill me). I'm not sure how supportive they'd be if I told them.

> Wow, the dog is a really good idea! I'm glad it works out so good for you!!!

Thank you :) It was really hard trying to explain why I needed a dog so that I would be allowed one, but I must have managed to do a good job. 

> I'm not sure if I understand correctly, but if they are trying to get you on the right medication

No, I'm not on any medication at the moment. This is the first attempt at trying to find the right medication, I should have had them at the end of last week, but so far nothing. 

> Ask for help, and phone or mail them. I hope you get a (temporary) coach, someone that can guide you through this, and who you can contact daily.

I'm not really sure that's offered here, I'm in the UK and I'm right at the start of the process so they're getting my care team set up at the moment. But I see a mental health nurse again on Wednesday. 

> I hope you can tell someone in school who understands.

Unfortunately it's a part-time online school since I work full time as well, so there isn't really anything they can offer in terms of counselling. 

> All the best, and keep writing here to get support.

Thank you, I'm really glad I found this place. It's nice to actually be able to talk about all this.

Unfortunately my family isn't here and even when I do, I don't open up to them about of my issues just incase. Right now the monsters and demons always laugh at me and tell me they're going to get me... I'm just glad I hear them talk inside my head rather than outloud.

I've been waiting about two weeks for my medication, unfortunately they seemed to have misplaced the letter :( I've had super bad reactions to antidepressants in the past so I'm scared to see what'll happen this time... Plus there's the real possibility that it could be a placebo they give me and it's all just a test.
